data.rationale: jcv_ceil needs to know the result of jcv_real_to_int is finite to prove that i + 1 is finite and that the return value is finite.
jcv_ceil needs to know that the truncated value i is less than or equal to v to prove the ceiling property (result >= v).
jcv_ceil needs to know that the fractional part is less than 1 to prove the ceiling property (result - 1 < v).
jcv_point_eq calls jcv_real_eq and needs to know the return value is either 0 or 1 to prove its own postcondition.

postconditions: ensures (pt->x == min->x || pt->y == min->y || pt->x == max->x || pt->y == max->y) ==> \result == 1;
ensures (pt->x != min->x && pt->y != min->y && pt->x != max->x && pt->y != max->y) ==> \result == 0;
